newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, light trade selling.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar off, light trade selling.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures dipped below support by midsession, pressured by light producer selling, floor sources said.

Benchmark July slipped to a low of 10.98 cents, where scale-down buying by the trade was holding the contract. Dealers expect a move under the low to trigger small stops, which could pressure July to its next downside target of 10.85 cents.
Heavy selling is expected to emerge at resistance, seen at 11.20 cents.
Meantime, a dearth of fundamental news and next week's annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association dinner in New York, kept the tone quiet, market sources said.

At 1142 EDT, benchmark July futures stood 0.11 cent per lb lower at 11.00 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.11 to 10.98 cents. Second-position October fell 0.11 to 10.79 cents, while the remaining months were 0.08 to 0.02 lower.
An estimated 6,433 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
